scenes.summary: You are required to upgrade the Control Nexus of Dijiang. This lets you construct more cabins or upgrade existing cabins.

lines.text: Welcome back, Endmin. The new Algorithm Expansion Chip is fully prepared. We can start immediately.
This upgrade will improve power output as well as system mainframe compatibility. It will let us construct additional cabins.
We can also upgrade our ⟦key|Growth Chamber⟧. The ⟦key|Reception Room⟧ will be getting more features as well.
Dijiang shall always serve as your capable support. I am pleased to be the one waking it to serve its functions.
So, as before, please proceed to the ⟦key|Control Nexus⟧, install the chip, and complete this upgrade.

options: Feels like meeting an old friend again.

lines.text: Data upgrade verified. New areas have been connected to the administrative system.
I have synced the locations of Working Sector cabins that can be expanded. We can now proceed to the said locations to continue our work.
This upgrade has added more ⟦key|functional cabins⟧. You can use resources to construct cabins that fit your needs.
And in accordance to what I mentioned earlier, we can also ⟦key|further upgrade⟧ these cabins.
As for the priorities of the construction sequence and allocation of construction resources, I shall leave those to your capable decision.
Once the cabin is constructed, please head to the ⟦key|Reception Room⟧. I shall provide you with more information at that location.

options: Let's start by constructing a new cabin.

scenes.summary: The new cabin is now operational. The Clue Exchange function of the Reception Room is also restored.

lines.text: New cabin online. Drivetrain load status is stable. Perhaps we will soon be able to repair other facilities.
Every sector of Dijiang is independently connected to the Control Nexus. This allows us to isolate or repair various sectors while keeping the vessel operational.
While you were constructing the new cabin, the Reception Room Intel Section has restored its functions.
Yes. Additional operator assignments are required for the Reception Room as well as other new or upgraded cabins.
Please pay attention to operator assignments and avoid the transgression of idleness.
The Intel Section has synthesized clues gathered by the SOW from multiple channels. You may compile them, and even share them with your partners.
⟦key|Clue Exchange⟧ offers significant benefits and is conducive towards our supplies gathering operations.
Good. I shall leave the arrangements and assignments to your discretion. May Veritas watch over thy path.
My pleasure. I shall assist you and optimize every onboard routines of Dijiang.
Good. I shall leave the arrangements and assignments to your discretion. May Veritas watch over thy path.

options: The number of tasks we need to follow seems to be increasing.
We'll continue to rely on your assistance...
